title: John Chrysostom on 1 Peter 2:21
body: “The exhortation again is derived from the example of his Master, and what he means is this; as He had done, so ought ye to do, for for this cause He "witnessed" (1 Pet.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on Galatians through Philemon

title: John Chrysostom on 1 Peter 2:22
body: “In reality, the people were subject to another curse, which says, "Cursed is every one that continueth not in the things that are written in the book of the Law." (Deut.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on Galatians through Philemon

title: John Chrysostom on 1 Peter 2:22
body: “However, since our discourse is concerning the Lord's body, come, and let us turn our thoughts to it, even that which was crucified, which was nailed, which is sacrificed. If thou art the body of Christ, bear the Cross, for He bore it: bear spitting, bear buffetings, bear nails.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on Galatians through Philemon

title: John Chrysostom on 1 Peter 4:16
body: “The name Christians was probably given by the Gentiles. The word appears but twice, besides here, in the N.T.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on Acts and Romans

title: John Chrysostom on 1 Peter 4:18
body: “The common view of the clause is that it means that the man is saved, but as if through the very flames, i.e., with the greatest difficulty.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on the Epistles to the Corinthians

title: John Chrysostom on 1 Peter 5:8
body: “Here He declareth Himself to be Master even as the Father, if so be that He is the Shepherd, and the sheep are His. Seest thou how He speaketh in a more lofty tone in His parables, where the sense is concealed; and giveth no open handle to the listeners?”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on John and Hebrews

title: John Chrysostom on 1 Peter 5:12
body: “Silas has also been suggested as a possible author. Of him we know even less than of Apollos. He was a prophet in the early Church at Jerusalem ( Acts xv.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on John and Hebrews
